title: Newmark Arranges $89 Million Sale of Emblem Health Hub Medical Office Building in Brooklyn, NY
summary: Newmark announces the Company has arranged the $89 million sale of Emblem Health Hub Medical Office Building (“MOB”), a 140,000-square-foot, trophy-quality MOB located at 101 Pennsylvania Avenue in Brooklyn, New York.
